main_text.p: Permittit quoque Deus ipse quandoque pios, atque à Dei semita nullatenus deflectentes, tentari à Diabolo, quò fides eorum conspicua reddatur, nec torpeat in ipsis Deo sacratus animus: Exemplum luculentum in Iobo habemus. Infcii quoque ac nolentes in Satanæ laqueos incidimus, ni rectam semitam constanter calcemus. Non credebat, dubio procul, juvenis ille, Cornelii Agrippæ Commensalis, (cujus meminit in Differtat. de superst. morbor. Orig. & Curat. §. 49 ex Delr. Disquis. Mag. lib. 2. q. 29. f. 2.) qui tantum curiositatis gratiâ, absente hospite, impetratâ musæi clave ab uxore Agrippæ, conjurationum aliquem librum volvere instituebat, non credebat ille, inquam, tantum illi rei periculi subesse, nec conjurationum Diabolicarum voluit se ipsum participem reddere, quin nec pactum apertum inierat cum præstigiatore, nec Dæmonis præsentiam vel exspectabat vel sperabat; at ni-

page.notes: Marginal notes: none legible beyond the running text. Several words in the Latin are faint or broken (e.g. "Commensalis" and "Delr."), transcribed as printed. Catchword "at ni-" is printed at the foot right; included as catchword and not in the text paragraph to avoid duplication, although it also begins the last line.
